Job Description:
Are you ready to step up to the New and take your technology expertise to the next level?

Join Accenture and help transform leading organizations and communities around the world. The sheer scale of our capabilities and client engagements and the way we collaborate, operate, and deliver value provides an unparalleled opportunity to grow and advance. Choose Accenture and make delivering innovative
work part of your extraordinary career.

You Are

As part of our Google Cloud Platform practice, you will lead technology innovation for our clients through robust delivery of world-class solutions. There will never be a typical day, and that’s why people love it here. The opportunities to make a difference within exciting client initiatives are unlimited in the ever-changing technology landscape. You will be part of a growing network of technology experts who are highly collaborative, taking on today’s biggest, most complex business challenges. We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. Come grow your career in technology at Accenture!

The Work

The Google Cloud CCAI Developer/Testing Engineer is responsible for the design, development, testing, and implementation of CCAI solutions on the Google Cloud Platform (GCP). In this role, you will play a critical part in shaping, implementing, and supporting client's contact center solutions, ensuring scalability, security, and optimal performance.

Key Responsibilities may include:
• CCAI Development: Design, develop, and deploy conversational flows using Dialogflow CX/ES. Integrate CCAI with other GCP services (e.g., Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions, Cloud Run) and external systems.
• CCAI Testing: Develop and execute comprehensive test plans and test cases for CCAI solutions. Implement automated testing strategies using appropriate frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, pytest). Conduct performance and API testing to ensure optimal performance and reliability. Analyze CCAI reporting and analytics dashboards to identify areas for improvement.
• Software Development: Develop and maintain code using Java, Python, or Node.js. Design, develop, and consume RESTful APIs. Utilize Git for version control and collaborate effectively within a team.
• CI/CD: Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated build and deployment of CCAI solutions.
• Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams (development, operations, and clients) to deliver high-quality solutions.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here's what you need

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Minimum of 3 years experience in at least one language (Java, Python, or Node.js)

Minimum of 2 years experience in the following:
• GCP Fundamentals: Understanding of GCP architecture, services, and billing.
• Compute Engine: VM creation, management, and networking.
• Cloud Storage: Object storage and lifecycle management.
• Dialogflow CX/ES: Experience in design, development, and testing of conversational flows.
• Contact Center AI (CCAI) Integration: Experience integrating CCAI with other GCP services and external systems.
• REST APIs: Experience designing, developing, and consuming RESTful APIs.
• Git (Version Control): Experience with branching strategies, merging, and collaboration.
• Test Planning & Design: Experience creating comprehensive test plans and test cases.
• Test Automation: Experience writing automated tests.
• API Testing: Experience testing REST APIs.
• Linux/Unix command line: Experience with basic system administration tasks.

Minimum of 1 year experience in following:
• CLoud SQL/Cloud Spanner: Database management and administration.
• Kubernetes (GKE): Experience with container orchestration and management.
• Cloud Functions/Cloud Run: Experience with serverless functions and container deployment.
• CCAI Reporting & Analytics: Experience understanding and using CCAI analytics dashboards.
• CI/CD Pipelines: Experience setting up and managing automated build and deployment processes.
• Performance Testing: Experience identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks.
• Cloud Security best practices: Experience understanding and implementing secure coding practices.
• Agile methodologies: Experience working in agile development environments.

Bonus Points if you have
• Google Cloud certifications (Google Certified Professional Cloud Architect, Google Certified Data Engineer, or Google Certified Associate Cloud Engineer) – There is an expectation that a certification in Google Cloud will be necessary after hire.
• Experience with other CCAI related technologies (e.g., Genesys Cloud, Five9)

About the job

Trust Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, youre a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.
As a Manager and Senior Analyst on the TS Responsible AI Novel Testing Team, you will be an expert in developing structured ways to test Google’s GenAI products with new and previously-untested functionality against safety, neutrality and fairness standards. You will draw on expertise across testing operations, policy, and AI systems and will partner closely with the technical abuse-fighting experts in TS to understand launch requirements, develop and implement testing protocols. You will leverage robust data analysis to provide quantitative and qualitative actionable insights on potential risks for mitigation by TS and product teams define and implement risk mitigation strategies. You will need to manage many stakeholders through effective relationship building, influence and communication skills. Your ability to think strategically, collaborate, and execute quickly will be instrumental in shaping the future of AI development, ensuring that Googles AI products are safe, fair, and unbiased.
At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. We partner with teams across Google to deliver bold solutions in abuse areas such as malware, spam and account hijacking. A diverse team of Analysts, Policy Specialists, Engineers, and Program Managers, we work to reduce risk and fight abuse across all of Google’s products, protecting our users, advertisers, and publishers across the globe in over 40 languages.

We’re very pleased to be expanding our product development team. We’re a close-knit group of innovators tha
t have previously launched very successful companies. We are looking to add a Senior Automation Test Engineer to our team in Pune.

You know the limitations of Selenium and you are motivated to learn new technologies. You are committed to quality, set high standards for yourself and pay attention to detail.

That’s a high level summary of what we’re looking for but before we dive into the detail, you’ll probably want to know who you are going to be working for and what your work environment will be like:

Who we are:

We are an Insurtech company with a core mission of leveraging ai algorithms and techniques to solve complex business problems. We like to think that solving these business issues for our customers helps make them better at serving their customers. Some of our applications help people who may be injured or have been in an accident. In our opinion that’s a worthwhile pursuit. While our current business vertical is insurance, we see our technology expanding to other business verticals with time.

We love what we do and not the least of which is that we have the opportunity to try out and ‘play’ with the latest advances in tools and technology.

Who you’ll be working with:

We are a collaborative, tight knit group of contributors and we try to foster a very supportive work environment. While we’re headquartered in the Chicago area in Lisle, our software labs are in Pune, India. We have decades of experience working with remote team members. We’re looking to expand our team in Pune, India.

You’ll find our technology managers a joy to work with; people with excellent technical skills, always willing to mentor, roll up their sleeves and get deep into technical issues. Our management possesses rare technical insight coupled with a remarkable business vision. You’ll be working as a key member of our technical team in what will be an amazing opportunity for you.

Your work environment:

We are a group of talented and dedicated individuals and though we are a software company, we have a ‘no insane hours’ rule.

We are not clock watchers. If you need to take off for a couple of hours to visit the doctor or dentist go ahead. We look at what you’re accomplishing, not how many hours you spend logged into your computer or in the office. We conduct meetings on a daily basis with our Chicago office so some overlapping hours are necessary.

Our work is performed using the latest technology and tools. We’re constantly innovating and improving our delivery capability by building our own components and tools as well as licensing new tech that we’ve tried and that works in our environment.

We are an open, collaborative, supportive work environment and suggestions are not just welcome, they are appreciated. You’ll find our product roadmap is exciting and full of opportunity. We believe in compensating our core team with higher than prevailing market wage.

You keep up with technology changes and trends.

You are skilled with developing Selenium test automation scripts on a minimum of one of Aurelia/Angular/React/Vue web application environments.

You are familiar with manual testing. Even though you are a Automation Test Engineer you have developed functional tests, their acceptance criteria as well as test data required for manual testing in the past.

You are able to work on multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

You are committed to quality, set high standards for yourself and pay attention to detail.

NodeJS experience is a plus but not necessary.
